notes: Compact and baseline exports have identical retained topology and edge costs.
Five-metre and fifteen-metre simplification affect visual polylines only. Coordinates rounded to 1e-5 degrees.
No graph pruning was used to achieve the measured compact-vs-baseline reduction.
This proof does not validate turn/access/conditional routing rules, visual quality, mobile memory or frame rate.
571 restriction members reference objects absent from the selected graph; the production compiler must classify these cases.
Benchmark endpoint selection requires a reachable destination; the closest Geneva node was on an unreachable directed fragment.
Memory byte counts are array capacities, not total browser peak memory.
